Date: 2027-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK/Streaming/Tool-calling) - Acme MAP draft

Hi James / Priya -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan focused on the Integration Build Plan milestone. The MAP includes milestones, owners, target close date, and dependencies. Highlights below; full MAP attached (ACME_MAP_Draft.pdf) and an integration spec (integration_spec.xlsx).

High-level Integration Build Plan (milestone):
- Goal: Production-ready SDK integration + streaming + tool-calling + structured outputs for customer workflows
- Target milestone complete by: 2027-03-18 (target close for MAP: 2027-03-31)
- Key responsibilities / owners (draft):
  - SDK integration (server + client examples): Dev Patel (Redwood)
  - Streaming / low-latency validation: Logan Wright (Redwood Eng)
  - Tool calling & external action wiring: Logan Wright (Redwood Eng)
  - Structured outputs / schema validation: Laura Bennett (CS)
  - Program owner / commercial sync: Marissa Cole (Sales)

Dependencies & risks:
- Security review / SOC 2 evidence (they will need our SOC 2 report and retention policy)
- Network whitelisting and IP ranges for dedicated tests
- DocuSign for SOW + any procurement steps
- Internal engineering availability: two sprints of focused integration work

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP and confirm owners/target dates by EOD Wednesday (Mar 3).
2) We'll schedule a 30-min technical sync with your engineering leads if you confirm SDK + streaming as priority.
3) I'll upload the MAP into HubSpot once we lock owners.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_Draft.pdf, integration_spec.xlsx

Thanks -
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: 2027-03-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK/Streaming/Tool-calling) - Acme MAP draft

Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap and draft MAP. A few quick items from our side after reviewing with the engineering leads: 

- SDK + streaming are our top priorities. We need language SDKs (Node + Python) and a streaming example for long-running chat workflows.
- Can we compress the target milestone to 2027-03-15? Q1 milestone pressure on our side.
- Security/compliance: we need your SOC 2 Type II and confirmation on data retention and egress (our legal wants to verify logs retention and whether KV cache persists beyond session).
- Procurement: we'll need an SOW and estimated MRF for dedicated testing. Can you surface a sample SOW/standard terms?

If you can share a more granular tech plan (owners + 2-week sprint tasks) we can lock internal resources. Also happy to do a technical sync Thu/Fri this week.

Best,
James
James Liao | Senior PM, Platform Integrations - Acme Corp
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: James Liao <james.liao@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration build plan (SDK/Streaming/Tool-calling) - tech breakdown + owners

James -

Appreciate the priorities. Below is a pragmatic breakdown we can commit to if Acme can provide a technical contact for the sync and approve the two-sprint focused window. I attached a working integration plan workbook (integration_plan_v1.xlsx) with task-level owners.

Proposed 2-sprint plan (sprint length = 2w):
Sprint 1 (Weeks 1-2):
- Task A: Node + Python SDK quickstart + example repo (Owner: Dev Patel) - deliverables: example apps, auth flow, README
- Task B: Streaming API smoke tests + client sample (Owner: Logan Wright) - deliverables: sample streaming client, perf notes
- Task C: Network prep (whitelist IPs, test endpoints) (Owner: Acme infra contact)

Sprint 2 (Weeks 3-4):
- Task D: Tool-calling integration (external action wiring, webhooks) (Owner: Logan Wright)
- Task E: Structured outputs schema & validation harness (Owner: Laura Bennett)
- Task F: End-to-end demo & runbook (Owner: Dev Patel + Laura Bennett)

Owners summary (Redwood):
- SDK integration: Dev Patel
- Streaming validation: Logan Wright
- Tool-calling: Logan Wright
- Structured outputs validation: Laura Bennett
- Commercial / MAP owner: Marissa Cole

Dependencies / notes:
- We can target milestone complete by 2027-03-15 if Acme confirms SDK + streaming priority and assigns an internal eng contact by 2027-03-04.
- Security asks: we'll provide SOC 2 Type II report and a data retention summary. Regarding KV cache: default behavior is ephemeral per-session unless configured; we'll document options.
- Procurement: sample SOW template available; I'll send to Marissa to attach to the MAP.

Attachments: integration_plan_v1.xlsx

Happy to join a tech sync Thu 3/4 at 9am PT.

Thanks,
Dev Patel | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
